verdict.rationale: Greptile can be driven by natural language, but mostly through an external coding agent. Its official MCP server lets Claude Code, Cursor and others act on prompts like "List unaddressed Greptile comments for PR #5" to fetch, resolve and fix comments and to manage patterns. Setup can also be handed to a coding agent, and plain-language comment replies train the reviewer. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface that doesn't depend on a third-party agent, documented coverage of the full product surface (config, triggers, rules) by natural language, and independent hands-on corroboration of the MCP natural-language workflow.
